text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in first paragraph and repeated position throughout","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its stance early and keeps that stance explicit across the body and conclusion."},{"evidence":"three organized body paragraphs on efficiency, safety, and convenience","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay groups its reasons into distinct sections that make the argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"explains fuel use leading to less CO2 and links that to pollution and climate effects","quality":"development of reasoning","description":"The essay does more than mention evidence by showing how the evidence supports the claim."},{"evidence":"uses article details like Sergey Brin, sensors, GPS, and projected releases in support of claims","quality":"evidence integration","description":"The essay weaves source information into its points in a more purposeful and connected way."},{"evidence":"concluding return to 'from human-driven cars to driverless cars'","quality":"conclusion effectiveness","description":"The ending restates the argument in a memorable way and closes the essay with a clear final position."}]}
